profiles.name: Attack / X-Dominance & 8-Meter Power
profiles.focus: 13yo Elite Club Attack — X-Dodging, Crease Finishing, Off-Hand Quickness & Knee-Safe Explosiveness

days.name: Monday
days.notes: Full explosive load. Focus on low-center-of-gravity roll dodges and quick-stick crease finishes.

drills.title: Dynamic Leg Swings
drills.cues: Front-to-back and lateral swings. Open hip flexors smoothly without forcing range.

drills.title: Kneeling Quad Stretch (Band/Wall)
drills.cues: Keep glutes squeezed and ribs down to gently lengthen quadriceps and patellar tendon.

drills.title: Low-Impact A-Skips
drills.cues: Soft, quiet forefoot landings with braced core and knee tracking over second toe.

drills.title: Broad Jumps to Stick Landing
drills.cues: Land softly with hips back and knees bent over toes; zero inward knee valgus.

drills.title: Lateral Line Hops / Skater Steps
drills.cues: Side-to-side boundary bounding with controlled deceleration on each plant.

drills.title: X-Roll Dodge Execution
drills.cues: Dummy at X. Parent feeds from high slot; tight roll dodge keeping stick protected and low-corner shot.

drills.title: Crease Quick-Stick Finish
drills.cues: Parent feeds from wing/X. Soft hands, zero cradle, quick-release bounce shot around crease dummy.

drills.title: Pick-and-Roll Separation
drills.cues: Dummy screen at wing, parent trails. Brush shoulder-to-shoulder off screen and explode inside.

drills.title: Slide Package Read & Quad Flush
drills.cues: Light walking quad/hamstring flush while visualizing early crease slide from X and skip pass to weak-side wing.

days.name: Tuesday
days.notes: Basketball Night: Phase 2 plyometrics zeroed out to protect knees and prevent lower-limb overload.

drills.title: Hurdle Trail-Leg Extensions
drills.cues: Controlled hip circumduction to unlock hip/quad range of motion.

drills.title: Standing PNF Quad Stretch
drills.cues: 5-second gentle isometric press into hand followed by relaxed quad lengthening.

drills.title: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
drills.cues: Drive through heel to activate posterior chain and unload quadriceps.

drills.title: Pick-and-Pop Partner Passing
drills.cues: Set blind screen on dummy, pop to open window with stick high, catch under light pad pressure.

drills.title: Wing Drive & 8M Step-Down Shooting
drills.cues: Sweep hard across top from wing cone, protect stick across frame, plant and rip low-to-low.

drills.title: Pick-and-Roll Reads & Calf Decompression
drills.cues: Gentle calf/hip flexor stretch while reviewing over/under screen reads (translates directly to evening basketball).

days.name: Wednesday
days.notes: Focus on sharp jab-step deception and high-wing roll-outs.

drills.title: Dynamic Frankenstein Walks
drills.cues: Keep torso tall; alternate straight-leg kicks to warm hamstrings dynamically.

drills.title: Couch Stretch / Deep Hip Flexor
drills.cues: Rear foot elevated on bench/wall; tuck pelvis under for deep quad release.

drills.title: Lateral Mini-Band Shuffles
drills.cues: Athletic quarter-squat stance; fire glute medius to stabilize knee alignment.

drills.title: Skater Jumps + 2s Stick Landing
drills.cues: Bound laterally and freeze for 2 full seconds on a stable, braced knee.

drills.title: Drop Steps to 5-Yard Acceleration
drills.cues: Open hips rapidly and drive arms for an explosive first three steps away from dummy.

drills.title: Rocker & Split Dodge Series
drills.cues: Dummy at top-left wing. Hard jab step one direction, crisp split cradle, finish on the run.

drills.title: High-Wing Roll-Out Shooting
drills.cues: Catch on wing from X feed, drive alley, roll away from dummy, change plane high-to-low.

drills.title: Fast-Break Spacing & Hamstring Stretch
drills.cues: Seated hamstring/adductor stretch while reviewing when to hold behind X for trailing attack.

days.name: Thursday
days.notes: Basketball Night: Second low-impact day to protect knee joint health.

drills.title: Dynamic Lateral Lunges
drills.cues: Sit hips back into heel; keep trailing leg straight for groin and quad mobility.

drills.title: Supine Quad & IT Band Stretch
drills.cues: Use strap or towel to gently release lateral knee tension.

drills.title: Banded Clamshells
drills.cues: Keep heels together and pelvis stacked; isolate external hip rotators.

drills.title: Cutter Timing & Catch-and-Shoot
drills.cues: V-cut off dummy into 8m arc from X feed; catch and release in under 0.5 seconds.

drills.title: Off-Hand Rapid Partner Exchange
drills.cues: Non-dominant hand quick-stick passing with parent; keep top hand relaxed.

drills.title: Crease Blind-Spot Read & Figure-4 Stretch
drills.cues: Supine Figure-4 glute stretch while mapping backdoor cuts behind ball-watching defenders.

days.name: Friday
days.notes: Focus on vision from X, deceptive look-offs, and aggressive riding lanes.

drills.title: High Knees & Butt Kicks
drills.cues: Rhythmic, low-impact cadence to elevate core temperature and warm quads.

drills.title: Kneeling Couch Stretch
drills.cues: Maintain tall posture; breathe deeply into tight hip flexors.

drills.title: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rocks
drills.cues: Drive knee forward over toes while keeping heel planted to improve shock absorption.

drills.title: Single-Leg Pogo Hops (Low Amplitude)
drills.cues: Quick, stiff ankle rebounds just 1–2 inches off turf to build tendon resilience.

drills.title: Resisted First-Step Band Sprints
drills.cues: Parent holds waist band; explode forward 5 yards with aggressive forward shin angle.

drills.title: Quarterbacking from X
drills.cues: Probe GLE behind goal, look off parent defender, thread crisp skip or crease feeds.

drills.title: Tough-Angle Crease Finishes
drills.cues: Absorb light pad bump from parent at GLE and reach across goal face to finish far pipe.

drills.title: Riding Traps & Lower-Leg Flush
drills.cues: Light walk and quad stretch while reviewing how to angle defenders toward sidelines on clears.

days.name: Saturday
days.notes: Full game-speed circuits combining dodging, feeding, cutting, and pressure 8-meter shots.

drills.title: Dynamic Leg Swings & Torso Rotations
drills.cues: Full-body rotational and hip prep for multi-directional game cuts.

drills.title: Standing Quad & Hip Flexor Flow
drills.cues: Smooth dynamic quad lengthening prior to high-speed cutting.

drills.title: Broad Jump to Multi-Directional Cut
drills.cues: Stick soft two-foot landing, react to parent hand signal, shuffle 3 yards left or right.

drills.title: Full-Sequence Attack Circuit
drills.cues: Dodge top wing dummy -> feed parent at X -> cut off crease screen -> catch & finish.

drills.title: Pressure 8-Meter Shooting
drills.cues: Parent applies light trail stick pressure; fake high and place shot low corner.

drills.title: End-of-Clock Possession & Static Stretch
drills.cues: Full lower-body stretch while reviewing final-minute stall/possession rules behind X.

days.name: Sunday
days.notes: Recovery Day: Zero joint impact. Lengthen quads, restore knee mobility, and refine stationary hands.

drills.title: Supine Quad Stretch
drills.cues: Heels toward glutes with gentle, continuous tension; slow nasal breathing.

drills.title: Half-Kneeling Psoas & Quad Stretch
drills.cues: Deep hip and quad lengthening to relieve patellar tendon pull.

drills.title: Hamstring, Calf & Figure-4 Flushes
drills.cues: Relieve hip and lateral chain tension pulling on IT band and knee.

drills.title: Stationary Wall-Ball / Parent Toss
drills.cues: Zero footwork stress. Focus on one-hand catching, soft wrists, and quiet cradling.

drills.title: Weekly Film & Tactical Review
drills.cues: Review pick angles, X-dodging timing, and slide reads from the week.

drills.title: Alley Dodging & Shooting on the Run

drills.title: Circle Positioning & Hip Mobility

drills.title: Dynamic Hip Openers & Quad Stretch

drills.title: Knee-Care Dynamic Flow

drills.title: Lateral Shuffle to Sprint
drills.cues: Low hips, soft plant.

drills.title: Top-Center Split to Sweep Shot

drills.title: Midfield Slide & Recover Cues

days.name: Thursday

drills.title: Quad & Ankle Mobility Prep
drills.cues: Deep hip hinge warm-up.

drills.title: Contested Ground Ball to Outlet

drills.cues: Smart shot selection late in possession clock.

days.notes: Speed transitions.

drills.title: Dynamic Warm-Up
drills.cues: Full lower-body prep.

drills.title: Pogo Hops & Acceleration
drills.cues: Stiff ankles, soft knees.

drills.title: 3v2 Trailer Catch & Shoot
drills.cues: Arrive late into high slot for clean catch-and-release.

drills.title: Backchecking Angles & Stretch
drills.cues: Take away middle of field first on defensive transition.

days.name: Saturday
days.notes: Game-tempo endurance.

drills.title: Full-Body Mobility
drills.cues: Prep hips and quads.

drills.title: Multi-Directional Cuts
drills.cues: Stick every landing.

drills.title: Draw-to-Goal Simulation
drills.cues: Win draw, sprint 30 yards, dodge dummy, finish.

drills.title: Static Stretch & Game Review

days.name: Sunday

drills.title: Deep Quad & Hip Restoration
drills.cues: Slow breathing and gentle holds.

drills.title: Stationary Two-Hand & Off-Hand Toss
